'''Lopar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] who served in the [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force]] in cooperation with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]], he was stationed at [[Dorn Base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lopar appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Specialty Goods Vendor for Imperial players on Hoth.<ref name="TOR" />
